title: Temporal Light Agent Execution Roadmap
goal: Run /abc work for up to 24 hours through deterministic Temporal workflows while keeping all mutable execution state, activities, history, heartbeats, commands, claims and evidence exclusively in the Harbor One Agent screen.

route.skill_selection_rule: ABC selects and bounds secondary skills and models before run start or through a recorded routing Activity. Planning never selects them.
route.model_record_rule: The selected and actual route are execution history in Agent, not Planning fields.

official_temporal_references.topic: local development server and persistent db filename
official_temporal_references.decision: Use temporal server start-dev with --db-filename for the local pilot and label it non-production.
Keep the default sandbox and prohibit network, filesystem, process, random, wall-clock and mutable-global access in workflow code.
Workflow code orchestrates serializable state only; every external interaction is an Activity.

official_temporal_references.topic: Signals, Updates, Queries and message history
official_temporal_references.decision: Use versioned Updates when the operator needs accepted or rejected readback, Signals only for asynchronous non-structural steering and Queries only for read-only workflow state.
Activities perform one bounded action and exchange references and digests instead of raw large payloads.

frozen_architecture.planning_truth: One immutable approved odysseus.planning.definition.v2 revision and content hash describe intent, DAG, gate requirements and done contract.
frozen_architecture.abc_truth: ABC owns queue selection, skill and model routing, mutation authority, claims policy, live-go interpretation, evidence acceptance and completion language.
frozen_architecture.temporal_truth: Temporal Event History owns deterministic run state, timers, Activity scheduling, retries, message processing and recovery.
frozen_architecture.odysseus_authority_truth: Odysseus owner scope, claims, leases, fencing tokens, live-go entries, effect receipts, evidence receipts and Git/provider authority remain outside Temporal and are checked by Activities.
frozen_architecture.agent_screen_truth: Agent renders one bounded projection joined from the pinned plan reference, Temporal execution history and Odysseus authority stores.
frozen_architecture.planning_screen_rule: Planning never receives this projection and never displays whether a run exists.
frozen_architecture.scheduler_rule: Do not build or activate a second durable heartbeat scheduler. Existing heartbeat and orchestration modules become adapters, compatibility readers or are retired after parity evidence.
frozen_architecture.writeback_rule: Execution never mutates the pinned Planning revision. A deliberate structural change returns requires_plan_revision; a completed run may propose a new Planning revision through the separately gated Planning apply path.
frozen_architecture.production_rule: The CLI development server is Temporal Light for local evaluation only. It must not be bound externally or represented as production-ready.

normalization_rules: Resolve latest_approved before workflow creation and replace it with a positive integer revision.
Read and validate the exact revision and content hash once before workflow start.
Reject missing dependencies, cycles, unresolved gate targets and an empty done contract.
Sort normalized node, edge, path and gate identifiers deterministically before hashing.
Store source and artifact references, never raw private document bodies, secrets or provider output.
The workflow must never reread a mutable Planning file.
pinned_workflow_input.start_rule: Only the Agent-side /abc handler can create this manifest and call the Agent run service. Planning handoff has launch_authorized=false.
pinned_workflow_input.conflict_rule: A revision or content-hash mismatch returns plan_revision_conflict and creates no workflow.

allowed_transitions: cancelling -> cancelled when all active Activities are cancelled or the cancellation grace expires
running -> completed only when every required node and runtime gate has verified evidence
any non-terminal state -> terminated only through an admin-only emergency action
run_state_machine.invalid_transition_rule: Reject before history mutation with invalid_transition and return the current run version and allowed commands.

slice_state_machine.claimable_rule: A pending slice is claimable only when every local dependency is succeeded, every required runtime gate is approved, the run is running, capacity is available and Odysseus grants a non-colliding fenced claim.
slice_state_machine.success_rule: A slice becomes succeeded only after Activity result validation, required checks, evidence verification and claim-safe writeback receipt.
slice_state_machine.failure_rule: After the initial attempt plus two retries, or after a material strategy change, the slice becomes failed or waiting_gate; it must not loop indefinitely.

catalog.name: resolve_execution_route
catalog.purpose: Perform non-deterministic skill and model routing when the pre-start ABC route requires revision.

catalog.name: acquire_slice_claim
catalog.purpose: Ask the Odysseus authority store for exact repo-relative paths, hotfiles, lease revision and fencing token.

catalog.name: execute_slice
catalog.purpose: Run one bounded worker against the claimed capsule and emit heartbeat checkpoints and a redacted handoff.

catalog.name: verify_slice_evidence
catalog.purpose: Run declared checks and validate scope, evidence, handoff and done conditions.

catalog.name: persist_execution_receipt
catalog.purpose: Persist bounded Activity, command and evidence receipts with compare-before-update semantics.

catalog.name: release_slice_claim
catalog.purpose: Release the exact fencing token after success, terminal failure or cancellation.

catalog.name: propose_planning_outcome_revision
catalog.purpose: Create a dry-run Planning proposal after verified completion; never alter the pinned revision.

retry_policy.meaning: one initial attempt plus at most two retries

idempotency_and_fencing.run_start: The Agent API requires start_request_id. Odysseus persists start_request_id -> agent_run_id -> workflow_id before or atomically with dispatch. A retry returns the existing run receipt.
idempotency_and_fencing.workflow_id_policy: Reject conflicting duplicate starts; never silently start a second workflow for the same start_request_id.
idempotency_and_fencing.command: Every command requires command_id, expected_run_version and idempotency_key. A duplicate returns the original receipt without applying twice.
idempotency_and_fencing.activity_effect: effect_id = agent_run_id:node_id:activity_type:attempt. Before every effect, read an existing receipt; after the effect, atomically persist the result under the same effect_id.
idempotency_and_fencing.claim_fence: Every workspace or authority write requires the current Odysseus lease revision and fencing token before, during and immediately before final receipt persistence.
idempotency_and_fencing.continue_as_new: One logical agent_run_id survives Continue-As-New. history_segment increments, workflow_run_id rotates and persisted command/effect receipts remain authoritative across segments.
idempotency_and_fencing.planning_writeback: A Planning proposal id is deterministic from agent_run_id, manifest_hash and completion_receipt_hash. Apply remains a separate Planning write gate.

updates.name: pause
updates.result: accepted state and new run version

updates.name: resume
updates.result: accepted state and new run version

updates.name: cancel
updates.result: cancelling state and new run version

updates.name: retry_activity
updates.result: new attempt receipt or rejection reason

updates.name: decide_gate
updates.result: approved, rejected, expired or waived decision receipt

signals.name: operator_note
signals.purpose: Append a bounded asynchronous note that does not alter DAG, scope, paths, gates or done contract.

signals.name: external_condition_changed
signals.purpose: Wake a waiting workflow so an Activity can re-evaluate an external condition. The signal itself does not assert the condition is true.

message_contract.structural_steering_rule: A request that changes DAG, dependencies, scope, allowed paths, blocked paths, gate definitions or done contract is rejected with requires_plan_revision and a Planning deep link.
message_contract.terminate_rule: Terminate is an admin-only emergency action, not a normal workflow Update. It requires separate authority and is always visible in Agent history.

long_run_policy.deadline_rule: deadline_at is part of the immutable manifest. At deadline, dispatch stops, active Activities receive cancellation, the workflow waits up to 300 seconds, then becomes timed_out.

continue_as_new.trigger: the earlier of six elapsed workflow hours, the SDK history-size recommendation or 2000 projected execution events
continue_as_new.precondition: all Signal and Update handlers have finished

long_run_policy.recovery_rule: Worker loss must not create a second logical run. Temporal retries after heartbeat timeout; Odysseus rejects the stale fence and grants a higher fence only after lease expiry or explicit release.
long_run_policy.no_progress_rule: A healthy heartbeat without durable progress may continue only until the manifest stale threshold; after that the workflow waits for operator input or fails according to the slice contract.

agent_operation_projection.purity_rule: AgentOperationProjection is a pure function of the pinned plan reference, persisted Temporal execution history and persisted Odysseus authority/evidence receipts. It must not read localStorage or chat prose.
agent_operation_projection.heartbeat_health_rule: The backend derives heartbeat health from observed server time and Activity policy. Frontend constants must not derive it.

history.rule: Return a bounded product projection, never raw Temporal payloads or an unbounded Event History dump.

agent_operation_projection.privacy_rule: Redact secrets, credentials, raw provider payloads, raw command output and unauthorized absolute paths before persistence and projection.

agent_api_contract.authority_rule: Every endpoint is owner-scoped. The projected allowed_commands list is authoritative; the frontend cannot enable an action by inference.
agent_api_contract.readback_rule: Every accepted write returns and then rereads the persisted command receipt and current run version.

visible: read-only pinned plan title, revision and hash
logical Agent run and current Temporal history segment
run state, deadline, current frontier and waiting reason
Activities, attempts, retries, timers and heartbeat health
paged execution history and SSE reconnect state
claims, leases, collisions and fencing failures
runtime gate decisions and required authority
evidence receipts, changed paths and publication stages within owner scope
backend-projected pause, resume, cancel, retry, decide-gate and steer controls
forbidden: silently rebasing to a newer Planning revision
choosing new allowed paths without a plan revision
enabling a command not returned by allowed_commands
granting commit, push, merge, deploy or provider authority
agent_screen_contract.navigation_rule: Agent links back to the exact pinned Planning revision for read-only inspection. A newer draft is a separate object and does not alter the run.
agent_screen_contract.dom_limit: Render at most 300 history or Activity rows at once; older events remain cursor-paged.
